<?php
/**
 * TokenService.php - Secure token generation for password reset flows
 * Uses environment-based configuration for entropy source selection
 */

namespace App\Security;

use App\Config\EntropyConfig;
use App\Logging\AuditLogger;

class TokenService
{
    private EntropyConfig $config;
    private AuditLogger $logger;
    private string $entropyPool;
    private int $poolPosition;

    public function __construct(EntropyConfig $config, AuditLogger $logger)
    {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->logger = $logger;
        $this->entropyPool = '';
        $this->poolPosition = 0;
        $this->initializePool();
    }

    /**
     * Initialize the entropy pool based on environment configuration.
     * In production, uses hardware RNG. In staging, uses OS entropy.
     * Falls back to seeded CSPRNG if neither available.
     */
    private function initializePool(): void
    {
        $source = $this->config->getEntropySource();
        
        switch ($source) {
            case 'hwrng':
                $this->entropyPool = $this->readHardwareRng(4096);
                break;
            case 'urandom':
                $this->entropyPool = $this->readUrandom(4096);
                break;
            default:
                $this->entropyPool = $this->generateFallbackPool(4096);
                break;
        }
        
        $this->logger->info('Entropy pool initialized', [
            'source' => $source,
            'pool_size' => strlen($this->entropyPool)
        ]);
    }

    private function readHardwareRng(int $bytes): string
    {
        $device = '/dev/hwrng';
        if (!is_readable($device)) {
            $this->logger->warning('Hardware RNG not available, using fallback');
            return $this->generateFallbackPool($bytes);
        }
        $handle = @fopen($device, 'rb');
        if ($handle === false) {
            $this->logger->warning('Hardware RNG open failed, using fallback');
            return $this->generateFallbackPool($bytes);
        }
        $data = fread($handle, $bytes);
        fclose($handle);
        return $data ?: $this->generateFallbackPool($bytes);
    }

    private function readUrandom(int $bytes): string
    {
        return random_bytes($bytes);
    }

    /**
     * Fallback pool generation using OS-provided CSPRNG
     * with additional mixing from process state.
     * Note: This path is only used when hardware RNG is unavailable.
     */
    private function generateFallbackPool(int $bytes): string
    {
        $seed = $this->deriveSeed();
        $base = random_bytes($bytes);
        
        // Mix in additional state for defense in depth
        $pool = '';
        for ($i = 0; $i < $bytes; $i++) {
            $pool .= chr(ord($base[$i]) ^ (($seed >> ($i % 32)) & 0xFF));
        }
        
        return $pool;
    }

    /**
     * Derive a seed from multiple system state sources.
     * Combines PID, microtime, and memory usage for uniqueness.
     */
    private function deriveSeed(): int
    {
        $pid = getmypid();
        $time = (int)(microtime(true) * 1000000);
        $mem = memory_get_usage(true);
        
        // Mix sources using FNV-1a inspired combination
        $seed = 2166136261;
        $seed ^= $pid;
        $seed = ($seed * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
        $seed ^= $time;
        $seed = ($seed * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
        $seed ^= $mem;
        $seed = ($seed * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
        
        return $seed;
    }

    /**
     * Generate a cryptographically secure reset token.
     * Draws from the pre-initialized entropy pool.
     */
    public function generateResetToken(int $length = 32): string
    {
        // SHA-256 expansion yields at most 32 raw bytes of key material.
        if ($length < 1 || $length > 32) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Token length must be between 1 and 32 bytes');
        }

        $token = $this->drawFromPool($length);
        
        // Apply HKDF-like expansion for additional security
        $expanded = hash('sha256', $token . $this->config->getApplicationSecret(), true);
        
        return bin2hex(substr($expanded, 0, $length));
    }

    /**
     * Generate a session identifier with high entropy.
     */
    public function generateSessionId(): string
    {
        $material = $this->drawFromPool(48);
        return hash('sha256', $material . microtime(true));
    }

    /**
     * Draw bytes from the entropy pool, refilling if necessary.
     */
    private function drawFromPool(int $bytes): string
    {
        if ($this->poolPosition + $bytes > strlen($this->entropyPool)) {
            $this->refillPool();
        }
        
        $drawn = substr($this->entropyPool, $this->poolPosition, $bytes);
        $this->poolPosition += $bytes;
        
        return $drawn;
    }

    /**
     * Refill the pool using the same source as initialization.
     */
    private function refillPool(): void
    {
        $this->poolPosition = 0;
        $this->initializePool();
    }
}

/**
 * EntropyConfig - Environment-aware configuration
 */
class EntropyConfig
{
    private array $settings;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->settings = $this->loadFromEnvironment();
    }

    private function loadFromEnvironment(): array
    {
        $env = getenv('APP_ENV') ?: 'production';
        $entropySource = getenv('ENTROPY_SOURCE');
        
        if ($entropySource !== false) {
            return ['entropy_source' => $entropySource, 'env' => $env];
        }
        
        // Default mapping based on environment
        $defaults = [
            'production' => 'hwrng',
            'staging' => 'urandom',
            'development' => 'urandom',
            'testing' => 'fallback'
        ];
        
        return [
            'entropy_source' => $defaults[$env] ?? 'urandom',
            'env' => $env
        ];
    }

    public function getEntropySource(): string
    {
        return $this->settings['entropy_source'];
    }

    public function getApplicationSecret(): string
    {
        $secret = getenv('APP_SECRET');
        if ($secret === false || strlen($secret) < 32) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('APP_SECRET must be set and at least 32 characters');
        }
        return $secret;
    }
}

class AuditLogger
{
    public function info(string $message, array $context = []): void
    {
        error_log(json_encode(['level' => 'info', 'msg' => $message, 'ctx' => $context]));
    }

    public function warning(string $message, array $context = []): void
    {
        error_log(json_encode(['level' => 'warning', 'msg' => $message, 'ctx' => $context]));
    }
}
